thread_tweets.text:
Repricing is imminent

and also - this is nothing against BUN, but the mcap on PONS is 5x what the actual FDV is. 80% of the supply is permanently locked / effectively burned, so its mcap is closer to $5 w/ 2150 holders vs. HMM at $9M w/ 15,700 holders.

BUN mechanics of claiming no holder holds more than 0.55% of the supply is also not what it seems when you compare that 0.55% number is out of the theoretical 100%, not the 20% circulating, which puts actual top wallet ownership closer to 2.75%

nothing against it - just think it inflates the distribution story & the position on pons isn't quite reflective of the actual mcap & top ownership of the coin is pretty much in line with everything else on this list, just doesn't reflect the same because most tracking software doesn't recognize the permanent locks the same way they do burns (even though they effectively are burns)
